about: Independent audit (one reviewer, 2026-10-20) of Pagewright against a 100-item inventory of Microsoft Word features, from general knowledge of Word, with repository evidence for each status. The planned second, adversarial review did not run. Five flagged overclaims were re-checked and confirmed; since then font choice, margins, ODT/RTF open and save, and AutoCorrect gained tests (see docs/feature-matrix.md), so a few statuses here are now conservative.
summary: Pagewright is not a reverse-engineered Word: no Word binary was analysed, it is built on the WordCraft engine from public specs, and no Pagewright file has ever been opened in Word (G-03). On this 100-item inventory, 26 items are verified (automated test plus a real-window run, on Linux only), 13 are tested only, 10 are partial, 6 are kept from files with no interface, 40 are not yet and 5 are not applicable (Microsoft cloud services and Copilot). Counting the not-applicable items as uncovered, that is about 39% working and checked, or about 45% if partial and kept-only items get some credit. Weighted by command surface it is lower: Pagewright's interface wires up 92 of the about 613 Word-shaped command ids its own engine declares (about 15%; the README's figure of 422 does not match my count). Spelling, comments, tracked changes, table of contents, footnotes, style editing, picture and table resizing, and all of Design, Draw, Mailings and the other views are missing, so honestly it covers the everyday write-format-save-print core, roughly a third of Word's features overall. Several feature-matrix claims are stronger than the tests behind them (margins, font family, ODT/RTF, odd/even headers, AutoCorrect), and keys.rs passes about 80 more engine shortcuts through without documenting or testing them; Ctrl+Shift+E, for example, can switch on tracked changes with no way to review them.

features.evidence: palette pw.new; core slice1::slice1_create_type_format_save_close_reopen; tools/gui_workflow.py slice1 (launch-blank)

Engine file.newFromTemplate, tools.templates and file.saveTemplate exist in vendor/wordcraft/crates/engine/src/cmd but are not in palette.rs or the format bar. .dotx/.dotm only open as ordinary documents (pagewright-core/src/filekind.rs).

pw.open; gui slice1 (Ctrl+O reopen and relaunch with the file), gui fidelity; roundtrip_check.py 10/10 (docs/evidence/roundtrip-pagewright.json). Synthetic corpus only (G-04), never opened in Word (G-03). The 'Open recent' menu (chrome.rs more_menu) has no test.
pw.save/pw.saveAs; core slice1 and features::every_core_feature_survives_save_and_reopen; gui slice1 and features check the saved XML and validate it with the Open XML SDK (0 errors)

core slice1::lossy_home_formats_ask_once_and_exports_keep_the_documents_home only saves .odt. No Pagewright test opens ODT, or opens or saves RTF. .doc opens through the engine importer with no fixture and cannot be saved (filekind.rs LegacyWord SaveMode::No). The feature matrix calls ODT/RTF 'Tested', which overstates it.

pw.exportPdf; core features::pdf_export_matches_the_layout; gui features (pdfinfo shows 2 pages, pdftotext checks the text); compare_pdf.py page counts match LibreOffice on 10/10. Not compared with Word (G-01).

features.feature: Export as web page, Markdown, plain text
features.evidence: palette pw.exportHtml/pw.exportMarkdown/pw.exportText; core slice1::lossy_home_formats... exports pdf, txt, html and md. LaTeX export (FileKind::Latex) has no palette entry and no test.

pw.print dialog (dialogs.rs Print); ui command_search::dialogs_open_for_commands_that_need_input; gui features (the job reached CUPS-PDF). Virtual printer on Linux only (G-09). No print preview pane, duplex or print-markup option (engine file.printMarkup is not exposed).

pw.recover; core features::recovery_keeps_unsaved_work_and_never_touches_the_original; gui recovery (SIGKILL, then restore). The window check only asserts 'app alive'; the restored content is shown in a screenshot. Copies can be up to 10 s behind (G-19).

pw.autosave (opt-in, local Word files only); ui command_search::autosave_writes_after_a_pause_and_refuses_files_it_cannot_keep. Not driven in the real window. Word's AutoSave needs OneDrive; this is a local equivalent.
Engine file.versions is not exposed. Pagewright keeps only crash-recovery copies.

features.feature: Protect and inspect: open/encrypt with password, mark final, document properties, Inspect Document
features.evidence: G-08: password files are refused with a message (pagewright-core/src/workspace.rs). Engine file.encrypt, file.protect, file.properties, file.inspect and file.privacy are not exposed.

features.feature: Damaged-file handling and a warning before content is lost (like Open and Repair / Compatibility Checker)
features.evidence: Fidelity guard in pagewright-core/src/fidelity.rs. core slice1::content_the_engine_cannot_keep_blocks_silent_overwrite_and_copy_keeps_original and damaged_and_mismatched_files_open_with_notices_and_need_confirmation; gui fidelity (original SHA-256 unchanged) and gui corrupt; 5/5 damaged fixtures handled. It counts elements but does not compare values (G-15).
pw.cut/pw.copy/pw.paste; core features::rich_clipboard_round_trip_keeps_formatting (HTML plus text). Exchange with other apps is untested.

Only 'Paste as plain text' exists (palette edit.pasteText, run by the command_search sweep). Engine edit.pasteSpecial and edit.pasteMerge are not exposed. Ctrl+Alt+V maps to edit.pasteSpecial only through the undocumented key passthrough in keys.rs, untested.

features.feature: Format Painter and Office Clipboard pane
features.evidence: Engine edit.formatPainter, edit.copyFormat/pasteFormat and edit.clipboardPane are not in the palette or toolbar. Ctrl+Shift+C/V map to them through keys.rs KeyMap, undocumented and untested.

format.bold/italic/underline (toolbar and Ctrl+B/I/U); gui slice1 reads the bold and italic runs back from the saved .docx; ui accessibility::typing_and_toggling_bold_through_the_interface and bold_reports_its_pressed_state; core slice1. Underline is not checked in the window.

Font and size menus in chrome.rs (format.font, format.size). core slice1 asserts the size after reopen, but no Pagewright test calls format.font, so the matrix's claim of coverage for fonts is not borne out. Missing fonts are shown with a stand-in (G-02).

features.feature: Other character formatting: strikethrough, sub/superscript, small/all caps, double underline, grow/shrink, clear formatting
features.evidence: palette format.strikethrough/subscript/superscript/smallCaps/allCaps/doubleUnderline/growFont/shrinkFont/clear; ui command_search::every_entry_runs_or_explains_why_not asserts only that each runs without a warning, not what it does.
Colour swatches and highlight menu in chrome.rs; core slice1 asserts colour 1E6A5A survives reopen; the highlight palette entries run in the command_search sweep.

features.feature: Change Case and advanced font options (spacing, scale, position, hidden, emboss/engrave, text effects)
features.evidence: Engine format.changeCase, format.spacing/scale/position, format.hidden, format.textEffects/outline/shadow and format.fontDialog are not exposed. Shift+F3, Ctrl+D and Ctrl+Shift+H reach them only through the undocumented keys.rs passthrough, untested.
para.alignLeft/alignCenter/alignRight/justify (toolbar, Ctrl+E etc.); gui slice1 (saved heading is aligned CENTER); core slice1

features.feature: Bulleted, numbered and lettered lists with levels
features.evidence: para.bullets, para.numbering (and lowerLetter); core features::nested_list_levels_are_written; gui features (5 numPr, nested item at ilvl 1)

features.feature: Multilevel list definitions, custom bullets/numbering, restart/continue numbering
features.evidence: Engine list.define, list.multilevelPreset, para.defineBullet, para.defineNumber, para.restartNumbering and para.setNumberingValue are not exposed.

features.feature: Paragraph dialog: line/paragraph spacing, indents, keep with next, keep lines together, widow control
features.evidence: Presets only: palette para.single, lineSpacing 1.15, oneAndHalf, double, addSpaceBefore, removeSpaceAfter, indent/outdent, pageBreakBefore. The command_search sweep runs them but does not assert the effect. No exact values, hanging or first-line indent, keepNext, keepLines or widowControl (engine para.dialog/spacing/indents/keepNext/keepLines/widowControl/hangingIndent are not exposed).

features.feature: Tab stops, ruler, paragraph borders and shading, Sort
features.evidence: Engine para.tabs, view.ruler, para.borders, para.shading, insert.horizontalLine and para.sort are not exposed.
palette view.marks; command_search sweep
Style menu in chrome.rs and palette para.style Normal/Title/Subtitle/Quote and para.heading1-3; gui slice1 (Heading 1 in the saved file; next paragraph gets the following style, W-05); core slice1

features.feature: Create, modify and manage styles; Styles pane
features.evidence: G-14. Engine styles.create/modify/manage/pane/updateToMatch are not exposed. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S passes through keys.rs, undocumented.
pw.find bar (find.rs) shows 'n of N'; gui slice1 and features use Ctrl+F to select text; palette edit.findNext/findPrevious
pw.replace (find.rs edit.replace/replaceAll); core features build() asserts replaced=3; gui features (Alt+A; the replacement shows in the PDF and the saved text)

features.feature: Find and Replace options and Go To (match case, whole words, wildcards, formatting, special characters, F5)
features.evidence: Match case and Whole words toggles exist in find.rs (untested). Engine edit.advancedFind and edit.goto are not exposed (F5 passes through keys.rs, undocumented). No wildcard or format search.

features.feature: Selection with mouse and keyboard (click, double/triple-click, drag, Shift+arrows, select all, select similar)
features.evidence: keys.rs::shift_extends_caret_moves; select.all runs in the sweep. canvas.rs implements double-click, triple-click and drag, but only click-to-place is driven (gui slice1). Select Similar Formatting and the Selection Pane (engine select.similar, arrange.selectionPane) are not exposed.
edit.undo/edit.redo (toolbar, Ctrl+Z/Y); core slice1::undo_and_redo_restore_text_and_formatting. The undo history list (edit.undoHistory) and Repeat (F4, edit.repeat) are not exposed.
text.pageBreak (Ctrl+Enter), text.lineBreak; gui features (2-page PDF); core features asserts page breaks
rt header-footer keeps 2 sections (docs/evidence/roundtrip-pagewright.json). Engine layout.break and layout.section are not exposed (roadmap item 9).
pw.insertTable dialog; gui features (one table in the saved file); core features (tables=1) and typing_into_a_new_table_fills_cells_without_extra_paragraphs

features.feature: Table rows/columns, merge cells, delete table, repeat header row
features.evidence: palette table.insertRowAbove/Below, insertColumnLeft/Right, deleteRow/Column, merge, repeatHeader, deleteTable; ui command_search sweep and merge_explains_itself_then_merges_a_cell_selection; core features asserts 4 rows after insertRowBelow; rt table-multipage keeps repeat_header

features.feature: Table design and sizing: styles, borders, shading, resize/autofit, cell alignment, split cells/table, sort, formula, convert text-table, draw table
features.evidence: G-10 (no drag resize). Engine table.style/borders/shading/resizeDrag/autofit/columnWidth/cellAlign/split/splitTable/sort/formula/fromText/toText/draw are not exposed.
pw.insertPicture; gui features (word/media part embedded); core features (pictures>=1); rt images keeps 2/2. Drag and drop is not supported (G-17).

features.feature: Picture formatting and arrange: resize, crop, rotate, position, wrap text, order/group/align, adjustments, styles, remove background, compress
features.evidence: G-10. Engine picture.size/crop/corrections/color/effects/removeBackground/style/compress and arrange.wrap/position/rotate/group/align are not exposed. Pictures go in at their natural size.
pw.altText, plus a description prompt on insert; gui features finds descr="Pagewright app icon" in the saved XML; core features; ui accessibility
Engine insert.shape, shape.*, insert.icon and insert.canvas are not exposed; the engine has no 3D-model command. fidelity.rs warns before drawings would be lost.
Engine insert.smartArt and smartArt.* are not exposed; fidelity.rs labels these parts 'SmartArt diagrams'; no fixture
Engine insert.chart and chart.* are not exposed; no fixture
pw.link (Ctrl+K) dialog, insert.removeLink; gui features (https://example.org/tour in the rels); ui dialogs::tests::urls; core features. Ctrl+click to follow (canvas.rs) is untested.
rt unsupported-content keeps 1 of 1 bookmark. Engine insert.bookmark/deleteBookmark are not in the palette; Ctrl+Shift+F5 passes through keys.rs, untested.
Engine insert.crossReference is not exposed.

features.feature: Comments (insert, reply, resolve, delete, comments pane)
features.evidence: G-07; rt unsupported-content keeps the comment. Engine review.newComment/reply/resolveComment/deleteComment and view.commentsPane are not exposed.
insert.editHeader/editFooter (palette and header bar in chrome.rs); Esc or Done leaves them (W-04); gui features (footer part in the saved file); core features asserts 'Running header'

features.feature: Different first page, odd and even pages, link to previous
features.evidence: G-11. rt header-footer keeps a first-page header (titlePg). No fixture has odd/even headers, so that half is unproven. Engine layout.differentFirstPage/differentOddEven/linkToPrevious are not exposed.

palette insert.pageNumber (bottom centre, top right); gui features (PAGE field in the footer, numbers in the PDF text); core features asserts the PAGE field. Number formats, start-at (engine layout.pageNumberFormat) and other positions are not exposed.
Engine insert.textBox is not exposed. G-20: the engine's own auto-fit text box test fails here.

features.feature: Cover page, WordArt, drop cap, signature line, Quick Parts/AutoText, embedded objects, text from file
features.evidence: Engine insert.coverPage, insert.blankPage, insert.wordArt, insert.dropCap, insert.signatureLine, insert.quickParts/autoText/docProperty, insert.object and insert.textFromFile are not exposed.
palette insert.dateField (updating); command_search sweep. Choosing a date/time format (engine insert.dateTime) is not exposed.

rt header-footer keeps both fields (PAGE, NUMPAGES). Only PAGE and DATE can be inserted. Engine insert.field, references.updateFields, fields.toggleCode/lock are not exposed (F9, Shift+F9, Ctrl+F9 pass through keys.rs, untested).
Feature matrix says 'Not yet in the interface'. Engine insert.equation and equation.* are not exposed (Alt+= passes through keys.rs, untested).
Only palette text.emDash, text.copyright and text.nbsp. No symbol picker (engine insert.symbol is not exposed).

features.feature: Draw tab: pens, highlighter, eraser, lasso, ink to shape, ink replay
features.evidence: Engine draw.pen/highlighter/eraser/lasso/inkToShape/replay are not exposed; pagewright-ui has no pen input path.

features.feature: Document themes, theme colours/fonts, style sets, effects
features.evidence: Engine design.theme/themeColors/themeFonts/styleSet/effects/setDefault are not exposed.
Engine design.watermark, design.pageColor and design.pageBorders are not exposed; no fixture; listed as not yet in known-gaps.md.

palette layout.margins normal/narrow/wide and custom values in the Page setup dialog (dialogs.rs); command_search sweep and dialogs_open_for_commands_that_need_input. gui features runs 'margins narrow', but no test asserts the saved margin values, so the matrix's 'Verified' is not borne out.
palette layout.orientation; core features asserts w:orient="landscape"; gui features (landscape section in the saved file)
palette layout.size Letter/A4 and the Page setup dialog; core features asserts the A4 width of 16838 twips. Never changed in the real window.

Engine layout.columns, text.columnBreak, layout.lineNumbers and layout.hyphenation are not exposed (the Ctrl+Shift+Enter column break passes through keys.rs, untested). known-gaps lists columns as not yet.
Engine references.toc/updateToc/removeToc are not exposed; roadmap item 10

Engine references.footnote/endnote/noteOptions are not exposed. Ctrl+Alt+F and Ctrl+Alt+D pass through keys.rs, undocumented and untested. No fixture; fidelity.rs warns if word/footnotes.xml would be lost; roadmap item 9.
Engine references.citation/sources/bibliography/citationStyle are not exposed; roadmap 'Later'
Engine references.caption/tableOfFigures are not exposed.
Engine references.markEntry/index and markCitation/tableOfAuthorities are not exposed (Alt+Shift+X and Alt+Shift+I pass through keys.rs, untested).

features.feature: Researcher / Smart Lookup / online pictures and stock images
features.evidence: Microsoft/Bing cloud content services; Pagewright is local-first (README). Engine references.researcher is not exposed. Counted as uncovered when judging parity.
Engine mailings.* (recipients, insertField, preview, finish, envelopes, labels) are not exposed; roadmap 'Later'

G-13. Engine review.spelling/proofing/suggestions/thesaurus/language and vendor/wordcraft/crates/proof (English word list and grammar rules) exist, but Pagewright never wires them up. F7 and Shift+F7 pass through keys.rs, untested.
palette review.wordCount dialog (palette.rs run()) and a live count in the status bar (chrome.rs status_bar); command_search sweep
Engine review.readAloud and readAloud.* (speech.rs) are not exposed (Ctrl+Alt+Space passes through keys.rs, untested).
Microsoft cloud translation and speech services; nothing in Pagewright or the roadmap. Counted as uncovered when judging parity.

features.feature: Track changes (record, markup display, accept/reject, reviewing pane)
features.evidence: G-07; rt unsupported-content keeps both tracked changes (1 deletion, 1 insertion). Engine review.trackChanges/accept/reject/markup are not in the UI. Caution: Ctrl+Shift+E reaches review.trackChanges through the keys.rs passthrough, so tracking can be switched on with no way to review it (untested).
Engine review.compare/combine are not exposed.
Engine review.restrict and file.protect are not exposed.
Engine file.accessibility and view.accessibilityPane are not exposed. Pagewright tests only its own interface (ui accessibility tests), not the document.
The page canvas (canvas.rs, wordcraft_render::render_page) is the only view; every gui_workflow.py scenario and docs/screenshots/01-19 use it; ui accessibility::the_page_reports_document_and_page

features.feature: Read Mode, Immersive Reader, Focus, full screen, Web Layout, Draft
features.evidence: Engine view.readMode/immersive/focus/fullScreen/webLayout/draft are not exposed (Ctrl+Alt+N and F11 pass through keys.rs, untested).
Engine outline.* and view.outline are not exposed (Alt+Shift+1..9 pass through keys.rs, untested). The sidebar outline is for navigation only.

pw.toggleOutline sidebar (chrome.rs outline); ui accessibility::outline_entries_are_announced_with_level_and_current_section and the_outline_scrolls_to_the_current_section; gui long (48 pages, screenshot 19; the window check is 'app alive'). No pages or search-results tabs, and headings can't be dragged to reorder.
pw.zoomIn/zoomOut/zoomReset/fitWidth and Ctrl+scroll; command_search sweep. One page, multiple pages and side to side (engine view.onePage/multiplePages/sideToSide) are not exposed.

features.feature: Split window, new window, multiple open documents
features.evidence: G-18 (one document per window). Engine view.split and view.newWindow are not exposed.
pw.themeDark/Light/System; ui tokens::tests::text_pairs_meet_wcag_aa and caret_is_visible_on_paper_in_both_themes; gui layout (screenshot 15). Pages stay paper-white; there is no dark-page option.

features.feature: Macros and VBA (record, run, VBA editor)
features.evidence: No VBA runtime. Engine tools.macros/recordMacro are not exposed (Alt+F8 passes through keys.rs, untested). fidelity.rs warns before vbaProject.bin would be lost. Not on the roadmap.
Microsoft's Office add-in store and platform; Pagewright has no plugin system and none is planned. Counted as uncovered when judging parity.

features.feature: Customize ribbon, keyboard shortcuts, Word Options
features.evidence: Engine tools.customizeKeyboard/customizeRibbon and file.options are not exposed. The only preferences are theme, outline and autosave (app.rs prefs.json).

features.feature: Tell Me / Microsoft Search command box
features.evidence: Command search (Ctrl+/) over 105 entries (palette.rs ENTRIES); ui palette::tests::synonyms_find_commands and command_search::every_entry_runs_or_explains_why_not; gui features and layout drive it.

features.feature: Familiar keyboard shortcuts and F6 pane navigation
features.evidence: keys.rs::familiar_shortcuts_map_to_engine_commands; ui accessibility::f6_reaches_the_toolbar_and_escape_returns_to_the_page; gui slice1/features use Ctrl+Alt+1, Ctrl+E, Ctrl+B/I, Ctrl+S/O/W, Ctrl+Enter, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+H. The in-app list (dialogs.rs SHORTCUTS) shows 28; about 80 more engine shortcuts are live but undocumented and untested. No ribbon KeyTips.

features.feature: AutoCorrect and AutoFormat as you type
features.evidence: The feature matrix says sentence starts are capitalised, but no Pagewright test asserts it (gui slice1 types text that is already capitalised). AutoCorrect options and list (engine tools.autocorrect) are not exposed.
docs/roadmap.md 'Later' (needs a separate decision because it conflicts with local-first); no code

features.feature: OneDrive/SharePoint storage, share links, Microsoft account
features.evidence: Microsoft cloud services; Pagewright is local-first by design (README). Engine file.share is not exposed. Counted as uncovered when judging parity.
Microsoft 365 cloud AI. Pagewright has no AI features; the engine's 'Agents' document.* commands are an automation API and are not exposed. Counted as uncovered when judging parity.

features.feature: Screen reader support for the editor
features.evidence: The AccessKit tree is checked by 8 tests in crates/pagewright-ui/tests/accessibility.rs. No real screen reader has been used (G-05). The page is drawn as an image, so it can't be read by line or word.

features.feature: International input: IME composition and right-to-left text
features.evidence: IME pre-edit text is drawn and committed (canvas.rs), but no real IME was tested (G-12). RTL paragraph direction (engine para.rtl/ltr) is not exposed. The unicode fixture round-trips.
G-06: Linux only; never compiled or run on macOS or Windows; no installer or signing
